fieldData.main-content:
RadXplorer is a comprehensive Radix Network explorer and dashboard, providing users with detailed insights into network activity, accounts, transactions, tokens, and validators. 

It acts as a powerful tool for easily tracking and managing data and Radix assets by translating complex raw data into human-readable statistics and graphs, catering to all users interested in the Radix Network and ecosystem.  

Main Features

Transaction Details

RadXplorer provides detailed information on any transaction within the Radix Network. This includes sender and receiver addresses, transaction value, timestamp, and associated metadata, making it easy to understand which accounts are operating within the ecosystem whether that be Market Makers, Foundation accounts or general users. This allows users to better understand the Radix Network in a more detailed manner. 

Account Insights

Users can access in-depth details about any account, including:

  • Portfolio Value: Real-time value of all assets held.
  • Transaction History: A comprehensive log of past transactions.
  • Holdings: A breakdown of assets, including tokens and NFTs.
  • Staking Rewards: Details of accumulated rewards from staking.
    ‍

This deeper insight allows a user to make more informed decisions when managing their assets and offers the transparency and traceability DeFi was made to provide, RadXplorer just takes it to another level. 

Exchange Flow Statistics

RadXplorer offers advanced analytics and historical data on the flow of assets through exchanges within the Radix Network. This feature helps users track liquidity, trading volumes, and trends over time. 

Bridge Flow Statistics

Detailed analytics on cross-chain bridge activities, including the volume and frequency of assets moving into or out of the Radix ecosystem, are available. This enables users to monitor how often assets are bridged in and out of the Radix Ecosystem, suggesting the rate of Radix adoption by users within other ecosystems. 

Ecosystem Token Overview

The platform provides a comprehensive view of all tokens within the Radix Ecosystem, including:

  • Historical Prices: Price charts for understanding token performance over time.
  • Market Capitalization: Insights into the size and health of the token’s market.
    ‍

Validator Overview

RadXplorer lists all validators on the Radix Network, providing detailed information such as performance metrics, staking rewards, and voting power. This helps users make informed decisions when selecting validators for staking.

Account and Transaction Management

Users can manage and label accounts and transactions for easier tracking and categorization. This feature simplifies monitoring activities, especially for those managing multiple accounts or large transaction volumes.

Upcoming Features and Improvements

Over the next few months, RadXplorer will roll out several new features designed to enhance the user experience and provide deeper insights into the Radix ecosystem. These updates aim to deliver more granular data, improve usability, and give users greater control over their assets, staking positions, and interactions with the network. 

Whether you're a developer, a trader, or a casual user, these new tools and functionalities will make managing and exploring Radix simpler and more efficient.

  • Radix Testnet Support: Explore and test transactions in a non-production environment.

  • Wallet Integration: Connect Radix Wallets to view accounts, staking positions, and rewards.

  • Staking Insights: Access historical rewards data and validator activity statuses.

  • Validator Pages: Detailed performance metrics for each validator.
    ‍
  • Account Management: Sort assets on the account page for easier organization.

  • Bridge Analytics: View detailed Maya transaction data on the bridge page.

  • Notifications: Alerts for fund transfers via email, mobile, or Slack.
    ‍

Why RadXplorer is Useful

RadXplorer is an essential tool for anyone interacting with the Radix Network. Its features provide transparency, facilitate better decision-making, and enhance user control over assets and activities. 

Whether you are a trader analyzing market trends, a developer monitoring network activity, or a token holder tracking staking rewards and your portfolio, RadXplorer easily simplifies complex network data and makes it accessible to anyone and everyone on Radix. 

Learn more about RadXplorer by visiting their website or following them on X (Twitter). 

All information about RadXplorer was provided by the RadXplorer team and has not been verified by Radix Publishing, RDX Works, or their associated companies.
